_note: 學習路徑內容建置・虛擬語氣：would rather (that) ＋ 過去式／過去完成式（eng.t_sub.subj.would-rather，學測／分科級）。同主詞偏好＝would rather ＋ 原形；要別人做／不做（現在或未來）＝would rather (that) ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去式；對過去的遺憾＝would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去完成式。高階防第二正解：不同主詞時用過去式（虛擬），非現在式或原形。皆標準英語，形式依 Cambridge / Oxford；claim 標 provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: would rather (that) ＋ 過去式／過去完成式
units.can_do: 我能用 would rather 表達偏好：同主詞用原形；希望別人（現在／未來）做或不做某事用 would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去式；對過去的遺憾用 would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去完成式。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When the preference is about the SAME subject, use 'would rather + base form': I would rather stay home tonight.
claims.verification_ref: 同主詞偏好＝would rather ＋ 原形；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To say what you would prefer ANOTHER person to do (now or in the future), use 'would rather (that) + subject + past simple': I would rather you didn't smoke here.
claims.verification_ref: 要別人現在／未來做或不做＝would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To express a preference about a PAST action (a regret), use 'would rather + subject + past perfect': I would rather you had told me earlier.
claims.verification_ref: 對過去的遺憾＝would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去完成式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: With a different subject, the verb is the PAST form even though the meaning is present or future; do not use the present tense: 'I'd rather you went now' (not 'go now').
claims.verification_ref: 不同主詞時動詞用過去式（即使語意為現在／未來），不用現在式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'Would rather' means 'would prefer'. When the preference is about the SAME subject, use the base form: 'I would rather stay home.' But when you say what you would prefer ANOTHER person to do now or in the future, use 'would rather (that) + subject + past simple', even though the meaning is present or future.
teach.zh_hint: would rather 等於 would prefer（比較想要）。當偏好是「同一個主詞」時用原形：I would rather stay home。但當你希望「別人」現在或未來做某事時，用 would rather (that) ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去式，即使語意是現在或未來。

teach.body: I would rather you didn't smoke in the house.
teach.zh_hint: 我寧願你不要在屋裡抽菸。不同主詞（you）用過去式 didn't smoke，語意卻是現在／未來。

teach.body: To express a preference about a PAST action, often a regret, use 'would rather + subject + past perfect (had + past participle)': 'I would rather you had asked me first.' Note: with a different subject the verb is always a past form, never the present tense.
teach.zh_hint: 要表達對「過去」動作的偏好（常是遺憾），用 would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去完成式(had ＋ 過去分詞)：I would rather you had asked me first。注意：不同主詞時動詞一律用過去形式，絕不用現在式。

teach.body: I would rather you had told me about the problem yesterday.
teach.zh_hint: 我寧願你昨天就告訴我這個問題。對過去的遺憾→ would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去完成式 had told。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（希望對方現在不要這麼做）：I would rather you ____ so loudly; the baby is sleeping.（我寧願你別講那麼大聲，寶寶在睡覺）

distractor_rationales.don't talk: 不同主詞(you)時用過去式 didn't talk，即使語意是現在；不用現在式 don't talk。
distractor_rationales.won't talk: would rather 後不接 will／won't；用過去式 didn't talk。
distractor_rationales.hadn't talked: 過去完成式用於對『過去』的遺憾；此處是現在正在發生，用過去式 didn't talk。

practice.feedback: 希望別人現在不要做：would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去式：I would rather you didn't talk so loudly。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（對過去的遺憾）：I would rather you ____ me the truth last night.（我寧願你昨晚就跟我說實話）

distractor_rationales.told: 對『過去』(last night)的遺憾用過去完成式 had told；過去式 told 用於現在／未來的偏好。
distractor_rationales.tell: 不同主詞時不用原形 tell；對過去用 had told。
distractor_rationales.would tell: would rather 後不再接 would；對過去用 had told。

practice.feedback: 對過去的遺憾：would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去完成式：I would rather you had told me the truth。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（同主詞的偏好）：I would rather ____ at home than go out tonight.（今晚我寧願待在家，不想出去）

distractor_rationales.stayed: 同主詞時用原形 stay；過去式 stayed 用於不同主詞的句型(would rather you stayed)。
distractor_rationales.to stay: would rather 後接原形，不加 to（不是 would rather to stay）。
distractor_rationales.staying: would rather 後接原形，不接 -ing。

practice.feedback: 同主詞偏好用原形：I would rather stay at home than go out。

practice.stem: 選出正確表達『我寧願你現在開車慢一點』的句子：
practice.answer: I'd rather you drove more slowly.
options: I'd rather you drove more slowly.
I'd rather you drive more slowly.
I'd rather you to drive more slowly.
I'd rather you had driven more slowly.

不同主詞(you)時用過去式 drove，即使語意是現在；不用現在式 drive。
would rather you 後直接接動詞，不加 to。
had driven 是對『過去』的遺憾；題意是『現在』開慢一點，用 drove。

practice.feedback: 希望別人現在做某事：would rather ＋ 主詞 ＋ 過去式：I'd rather you drove more slowly。

practice.stem: 用 would rather 改寫（希望對方現在不要做）：'Please don't use my phone.' → 'I'd rather you ____.'
practice.answer: I'd rather you didn't use my phone.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：不同主詞用過去式：I'd rather you didn't use my phone。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 純文字朗讀＋語調模仿（無音檔，自己朗讀→自評）：rather 重讀以傳達偏好；對方句的過去式動詞(didn't／went)輕讀但清楚，語氣客氣不命令。

lines.text: I'd rather you called me before you come over.
lines.intonation: rather 重讀、called 輕讀、句尾下收，語氣客氣

lines.text: I'd rather you hadn't said that to her.
lines.intonation: hadn't said 稍清楚、句尾下收，帶遺憾語氣
